def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Improved version of the empirical equation to model log10(|ID|/A) for OTFT p-channel Org2."""
    
    # Extract the different parameters from the parameters array
    Vt = parameters[0]  # Threshold voltage
    Kp1 = parameters[1]  # Subthreshold slope factor at VDS = 0
    Kp2 = parameters[2]  # Subthreshold slope factor at VDS > 0
    S = parameters[3]  # Saturation factor
    A = parameters[4]  # Normalization factor
    
    # Compute different components of the equation
    VGS_sqrt = np.sqrt(gate_voltage_abs - Vt)
    dndVDS_sqrt = Kp1 * np.exp((gate_voltage_abs - Vt) / (Kp2 * drain_voltage_abs))
    
    # Recombine the components
    id = S * A * dndVDS_sqrt * (1 - np.exp((-drain_voltage_abs + VGS_sqrt) / VGS_sqrt))
    
    # Return the log10 of the drain current normalized by A
    return np.log10(np.abs(id) / A)
